audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls this a 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' while diff is set to HARD and the Emerald+ win rate is 46.12% over 245 games.
audit.why: A sub-50% win rate with diff already flagged HARD cannot render as favoured at 4/10 difficulty.
audit.corrected: diffRating 7/10, breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line rewritten as hard.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five level rows disagree with the packet chart and with the matchup's own why text: Level 1 is Kennen although whys[0] says even; Levels 4-5 are Kennen although whys[3] says he out-trades; Level 6 is 'Skill' although whys[4] calls it Kennen's single best window; First item is Kennen although whys[5] says genuinely even; 2+ items is Kennen although the late paragraph says the lane slips away.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger heals Warwick for his on-hit magic damage below 50% health and triples it below 25%, so chip does not stick. Blood Hunt (80s at rank 1, 4000 range) gives move speed toward anyone under 50%, closing Kennen's kite range from 4-5 onward.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = Warwick, Level 6 = Kennen, First item = Skill, 2+ items = Warwick; levels 2 and 3 stay Kennen.

audit.why: Kennen's 2-3 poke window, level 6 and first item are right. Warwick's spikes are Blood Hunt rank-ups (80s down to 40s) and Infinite Duress at 110/90/70s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text claims Kennen 'stun-locks him THROUGH his Infinite Duress suppress'. Suppression is not something you act through — the supported claim is that CC on Warwick cancels the channel, and that Kennen must land his stun before the leap connects. Jaws of the Beast's max-health damage is also never stated where HP and armour are discussed.
audit.why: Riot's text: R 'leaps in a direction, suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds' at 25000 range, and the kit marks it channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it. Q 'deals damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt', 365 range, 8s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: R first so the mark stun lands before the leap; name Jaws of the Beast's max-health damage where melee range is discussed.
